source_gate_vocabulary.project_authority: Current project PFD, P&ID, line list, equipment map, design basis, or approved document.
source_gate_vocabulary.process_basis: Same-case Aspen export or accepted process document with units and basis.
source_gate_vocabulary.deterministic_derivation: Deterministic calculation from accepted project/process inputs.
source_gate_vocabulary.engineering_decision: Explicit human engineering choice with applicability and approval state.
source_gate_vocabulary.standard_evidence: Applicable standard identity, version, scope, and page/table lookup.
source_gate_vocabulary.same_equipment_software: Same-tag EDR, SW6, Column Internals, stress, or other verified software result.
source_gate_vocabulary.vendor_evidence: Same-duty vendor curve, map, datasheet, guarantee, or quotation.
source_gate_vocabulary.mechanical_evidence: Same-equipment mechanical calculation, drawing, or fabrication design.
source_gate_vocabulary.safety_operability_evidence: Same-service relief, control, operability, fire, seismic, or compatibility review.
source_gate_vocabulary.formal_evidence_state: A0-A4 evidence state machine and unresolved-evidence ledger.

selection_impact_vocabulary.identity: Determines item identity, family, or subtype.
selection_impact_vocabulary.calculation_input: Feeds a deterministic sizing or rating equation.
selection_impact_vocabulary.candidate_selection: Changes type, standard series, or candidate suitability.
selection_impact_vocabulary.formal_model_gate: Does not choose by itself but gates formal model promotion.
selection_impact_vocabulary.safety_and_operability: Changes safe operating or controllability acceptance.
selection_impact_vocabulary.system_reliability: Changes count, duty/standby, or reliability arrangement.
selection_impact_vocabulary.delivery_only: Required for customer overview delivery but does not choose the model.
